answer: Proof of Stake provides Sybil resistance by anchoring identity to capital. Instead of allowing agents to wander through the network creating infinite free identities, the system requires a financial stake, acting as a beacon of commitment. An attacker attempting to flood the wharf of the consensus layer must lock significant value, ensuring that the cost to gain majority influence scales linearly with the economy's total supply, thereby rendering mass-identity spoofing economically irrational.
